headline: Exchange Intake Rises To 1,384.4 Million Dollars From 1,182.2 Million, Led By Binance
narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 venues rose to a 1,384.4 million dollar inflow, 0.5078 percent of the 272.7 billion dollars held there excluding each venue's own token, from a 1,182.2 million dollar inflow at 0.4325 percent. Binance accounts for 850.4 million dollars of the current intake, Bitfinex for 200.9 million, Gate for 193.3 million, and Deribit for 178.5 million, while Bitstamp posted a 131.1 million dollar outflow. The pipe sums the 24-hour change in dollars held on the venues excluding each exchange's own token, so the higher print means more clean-asset value arrived than on the prior reading, and Binance was the largest arrival.
author: jordan
